home.freeSubtitle: Start here — these are open right away

win.title: Solved!
win.subtitle: The picture is complete
win.replayNote: Replayed — a fifth of the full reward

unlock.title: Unlock this picture?

shop.success: Thank you! The picture is unlocked.
shop.notAvailable: Payment is not connected yet — it arrives with Stripe. For now, unlock pictures with points.

auth.title: Sign in to Puzzlies
auth.subtitle: So your points, collection and purchases stay yours on every device
auth.purchaseSubtitle: An account keeps a bought picture yours forever — even after you switch browser or phone.
auth.sentHint: Open the link from the email to finish signing in. No password to invent.
auth.demoNotice: Demo sign-in: no real email is sent yet, the account lives in this browser only.
auth.saveProgressHint: Sign in so your points and unlocked pictures survive a cleared browser.
auth.linked: Guest progress moved into your account
auth.why2: Points and collection on every device
auth.why3: No passwords — just a link in your inbox
auth.providerUnavailable: This sign-in method isn't connected yet. Use the email link instead.
auth.checkSpam: No email after a minute? Have a look in your spam folder.
auth.sendFailed: Could not send the email. Try again in a minute.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestNote: Progress is stored in this browser only.
profile.historyEmpty: Empty for now — solve your first puzzle!
profile.resetConfirm: Really reset all progress and points?
profile.deleteNote: To delete your account and all its data, write to the address in the privacy policy.

seo.site: Puzzlies — jigsaw puzzles in your browser: solve pictures, earn points and unlock new ones. Free, no sign-up, on phone and desktop.
seo.puzzle: Solve the “{title}” jigsaw online — 12, 48, 108 or 300 pieces. Right in your browser, no sign-up.
seo.category: {blurb}. {n} jigsaw puzzles to solve free in your browser.

packs.title: Top up points
packs.subtitle: Points unlock any picture. The bigger the pack, the better the rate.
packs.notConfigured: Payment is not connected yet. We are setting up a provider — top-ups will work as soon as it is ready.
packs.needAccount: Sign in first, so your points do not get lost.
packs.failed: Could not start the payment. Try again in a minute.
packs.success: Thank you! Your points have been added.
packs.pending: Payment is being processed. Your points will appear in a few minutes.
packs.okBody: They are in your balance already. Time to pick which picture opens first.
packs.cancelledBody: Nothing was charged. Come back whenever you like.
packs.pendingBody: Your points will appear in a few minutes. Solve something free meanwhile.
packs.failedBody: Nothing was charged. If it was, write to us and we will sort it out.
packs.unfinishedBody: If you have already paid, the points will arrive within minutes and there is nothing to do. If not, you can pay now or cancel.

board.title: Leaderboard
board.subtitle: Average time at each difficulty. Only the same number of pieces can be compared, so every difficulty has its own table.
board.empty: Nobody here yet. The table starts at {n} pictures solved at this difficulty.
board.note: Your best time for each picture is what counts. You appear after solving at least {n} at this difficulty.
board.signInHint: Sign in to join the table and see where you stand.
board.nameHint: Without a name you appear on the board as “Player” with a random code. Your email is never shown to anyone.
board.noName: On the board you appear as “Player {handle}”. Set a name so people know you.
